ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

14. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.

16. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

17. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

18. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.

20. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Plants its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants its resources.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Animals resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Energy resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Sounds that alert us and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Harmful effects of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping safe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
